2022 Hyundai Tucson L 1.5T DCT GLX Elite Brief Specs

Basic Parameters

• Model: 2022 Hyundai Tucson L, 5-door 5-seat compact gasoline SUV, FWD

• Powertrain: 1.5T turbo inline-4 petrol engine (200hp / 253N·m), 7-speed dry DCT

• Dimension: 467018651690mm, wheelbase 2755mm

• Fuel consumption: 6.1L/100km NEDC combined

• Max speed: 205km/h, fuel tank 54L

• Suspension: Front MacPherson independent, rear multi-link independent

Exterior

• LED headlights & LED daytime running lights

• 18-inch alloy wheels (235/60 R18 tires)

• Heated power-adjustable side mirrors

• Front & rear parking sensors + rear view camera

• Side blind spot monitoring

• Rear windshield defroster

Interior & Comfort

• Faux leather seats

• Keyless entry & one-button start

• Multi-function steering wheel with cruise control

• Automatic air conditioning with PM2.5 filter

• Central touch screen, Bluetooth audio

• Electronic parking brake & auto hold

• Rear air outlets

Safety

• 6 airbags (front, side & curtain)

• ABS, EBD, ESP, hill descent control

• Real-time tire pressure display

• Forward collision warning, active brake assist

• ISOFIX child seat fixing interface
